commands.review_summary:
The branch adds non-mutating review-required Policy doctor repair previews for Gateway bind and node-command findings and preserves skipped repair changes in the structured doctor repair flow.

PR surface: Source +153, Tests +122. Total +275 across 5 files.

Reproducibility: yes. for the review blocker: the PR diff adds Gateway review-required preview hooks, while current `docs/cli/policy.md` still documents only automatic repairs and manual URL-fetch behavior. Runtime bug reproduction is not applicable because this is a feature PR.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A narrow docs-only repair can address the remaining blocker; draft status and security-boundary acceptance remain maintainer-handled afterward.

target.title: policy: preview review-required gateway repairs
target.body:
## Summary
- Restacked on current `main` after #99731 merged.
- Adds review-required `doctor --fix` previews for Gateway policy findings that should not be auto-mutated:
  - `policy/gateway-non-loopback-bind`: previews setting `gateway.bind=loopback` for `gateway.bind` and `gateway.customBindHost` non-loopback findings.
  - `policy/gateway-node-command-denied`: previews appending the missing command to `gateway.nodes.denyCommands`.
- Preserves skipped repair preview `changes` in the structured repair flow so review-required guidance is visible without counting the check as repaired.

## Real behavior proof
Behavior or issue addressed:
`doctor --fix` surfaces review-required preview guidance for Gateway bind and Gateway node-command policy findings without mutating config or counting the check as repaired.

Real environment tested:
Windows PowerShell in `C:\src\openclaw-policy-review-previews-push`, source checkout at PR head `842b5605`, rebased on upstream `main` `6235344006` after #99731 merged.

Exact steps or command run after this patch:
1. `git diff --check upstream/main..policy-doctor-review-required-previews`
2. `rg -n "<<<<<<<|=======|>>>>>>>" extensions/policy/src/doctor src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.ts src/flows/doctor-repair-flow.test.ts`
3. `git diff --stat upstream/main..policy-doctor-review-required-previews`
4. `git log --oneline --decorate --graph upstream/main..policy-doctor-review-required-previews`

Evidence after fix:
Whitespace check exited 0. Conflict marker search returned no matches. The final PR diff is five files, 278 insertions and 3 deletions: `review-required-repairs.ts`, gateway scope repair hooks, policy doctor preview tests, and repair-flow skipped-preview propagation. The branch now contains one PR commit on current `main`: `842b5605 policy: preview review-required gateway repairs`.

Observed result after fix:
The preview repair returns `status: skipped`, reason `policy repair requires review before changing config`, review warning/change text, and dry-run-safe config effects; it does not return a mutated config.

What was not tested:
Focused Vitest was not rerun locally because this clean push worktree has no `node_modules`. GitHub CI is running on pushed PR head `842b5605`.

## Stack
- Base: `main`
- Follow-up: #101336 adds agent/tool review-required previews on top of this slice.
